busy.speaker: Sarah
busy.text: I've got a pickup line in my head already. Walk with me another day.

choice_line.speaker: Sarah
choice_line.text: Friday. I've got twenty minutes before the school pickup.

choices.text: What does the week actually need?
Sunday is at ten, if you want it.

heard.speaker: Sarah
heard.text: The side door sticks, and the nursery smells like a closet. I'll think about Sunday. No promise.

invited.speaker: Sarah
invited.text: Ten o'clock. I'll write it down. That's a note, not a yes.

thinking.speaker: Sarah
thinking.text: I'm still thinking. Don't count chairs on my account.

after_saturday.speaker: Sarah
after_saturday.text: Sunday's tomorrow. I haven't decided. The kids know where the church is.

after_sunday.speaker: Sarah
after_sunday.text: I came. The kids know where the church is. That's as far as I've decided.

request_fresh_busy.speaker: Sarah
request_fresh_busy.text: You've already got enough people waiting on you. Catch me when one of those is done.

request_fresh_ask.speaker: Sarah
request_fresh_ask.text: I'm putting a meal together. If the church garden has lettuce and carrots to spare, I can use them.

request_fresh_accepted.speaker: Sarah
request_fresh_accepted.text: Two heads of lettuce and two bunches of carrots. Find me here when you've got them. No rush, but the table fills up.

request_fresh_later.speaker: Sarah
request_fresh_later.text: That's fine. The kids eat either way.

request_fresh_wait.speaker: Sarah
request_fresh_wait.text: Whenever the garden's ready. Lettuce and carrots. I can wait.

request_fresh_deliver.speaker: Sarah
request_fresh_deliver.text: That's everything. I'll set it with the rest. Come by if you want a plate later.

request_fresh_done.speaker: Sarah
request_fresh_done.text: The table was easier this week. The kids noticed.

after_week_belong.speaker: Sarah
after_week_belong.text: The kids asked if the nursery smells any better. I told them I'd look. That's new.

after_week_note.speaker: Sarah
after_week_note.text: The kids still know where the church is. I'm not making a new promise this week.
